script_text: Stop, Aquarius — the universe slammed a door in your face tonight. Your Air element is being forced to release control over resources you desperately want to keep stable. If you're single, Venus is activating your 7th House of Partnerships, pulling you toward a connection through a mutual friend — stay open to chemistry you didn't plan for. Taken? Your 10th House of Career is under Saturn's strict eye, so avoid impulsive decisions about promotions or contracts until tomorrow clears this tension. Do not lend money to anyone today — that Mars-Uranus square could make every transaction blow up by sunset. Subscribe so you don't miss what Uranus is about to unleash for Aquarius this week.
